scripts.build: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run build -w @otter/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @otter/server" "npm run dev -w @otter/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @otter/shared && npm run test -w @otter/server && npm run test -w @otter/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @otter/shared && npm run typecheck -w @otter/server && npm run typecheck -w @otter/web
scripts.test:model:low-signal: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:low-signal -w @otter/server
scripts.test:model:expression: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:expression -w @otter/server
scripts.test:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test -w @otter/server -- emotion && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js --validate-only
scripts.test:model:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js --model
scripts.report:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-expression-report.js
scripts.test:memory: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:memory -w @otter/server
scripts.test:model:memory: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:memory -w @otter/server
scripts.prepackage:testable: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:demo && npm run test:e2e:full && npm run test:model
